description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Insightly CRM Contacts/Leads/Organisations via emulated upsert. Insightly has no native upsert endpoint -- this searches GET /{object_type}/Search?field_name=X&field_value=Y, then PUTs the match or POSTs a new record. Search-then-write, not atomic.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Insightly Contact/Lead/Organisation (upserted via dedupe_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / rows_skipped_no_key). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Insightly.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

object_type.label: Object Type
object_type.description: Target Insightly object type. Only 'Contacts' gets CONTACTINFOS email/phone nesting.

dedupe_field.label: Dedupe Field
dedupe_field.description: fields_map value used to search for an existing record before create-or-update. MUST be present in fields_map values.

dedupe_search_field_name.label: Dedupe Search Field Name
dedupe_search_field_name.description: Insightly field_name passed to GET /{object_type}/Search. Defaults based on dedupe_field (EMAIL_ADDRESS / PHONE sentinels, else dedupe_field verbatim).

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Insightly field name. Values 'email'/'phone' nest into CONTACTINFOS (Contacts only); everything else is a flat field name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). No batch endpoint -- 1 search + 1 write per row.

name: Insightly Record Upsert
